## DELIVERABLE 2: GENERAL CV (LaTeX)

### Format Requirements

Use EXACTLY the same LaTeX document class, structure, and commands as `reference/cv_baseline/cv_english.tex`. Below is the complete class file and template you must follow.

#### Document Class: `thejus_cv.cls`

```latex
\NeedsTeXFormat{LaTeX2e}
\ProvidesClass{thejus_cv}[2026/03/06 Custom CV Class]

\LoadClass[9pt, a4paper]{extarticle}

% --- Packages ---
\RequirePackage[margin=1.2cm, top=1.0cm, bottom=0.8cm]{geometry}
\RequirePackage{paracol}
\RequirePackage{xcolor}
\RequirePackage{graphicx}
\RequirePackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{calc, shapes.geometric}
\RequirePackage{fontawesome5}
\RequirePackage{enumitem}
\RequirePackage{dashrule}
\RequirePackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\RequirePackage[T1]{fontenc}
\RequirePackage{tgheros}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}
\RequirePackage{enumitem}
\setlist{nosep, leftmargin=*, topsep=0.2em, itemsep=0.2em}
% --- Colors ---
\definecolor{cvcyan}{HTML}{19B5CA}
\definecolor{cvtext}{HTML}{333333}
\definecolor{cvgray}{HTML}{7A7A7A}
\definecolor{cvlightgray}{HTML}{E0E0E0}

% --- Global Settings ---
\color{cvtext}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=*, label={\textbullet}, itemsep=0.15em, topsep=0.1em}
\columnratio{0.60}
\setlength{\columnsep}{1.5cm}

% --- Custom Commands ---
% \cvheader{name}{title}{phone}{email}{link}{location}
% \cvsection{title}
% \cvexperience{title}{company}{dates}{location}{content}
% \cvstrength{icon}{title}{text}
% \cvskills{category}{list}
% \cvlanguage{language}{level}{dots}
```

**Available commands and their arguments:**
- `\cvheader{name}{title}{phone}{email}{link}{location}` — cyan header with photo
- `\cvsection{title}` — bold uppercase section with rule
- `\cvexperience{title}{company}{dates}{location}{content}` — experience entry
- `\cvstrength{icon}{title}{text}` — right-column strength box
- `\cvskills{category}{list}` — skills category
- `\cvlanguage{language}{level}{dots}` — language with 1-5 dot rating

#### Template Structure (follow cv_english.tex exactly)

The CV must have this exact structure:
1. **Header** — Name, title subtitle, phone, email, website, address
2. **Personal details row** — birthdate, marital status, nationality (white text on cyan)
3. **Links row** — LinkedIn, GitHub, Google Scholar (white text on cyan)
4. **Two-column layout** (60/40 split via `\begin{paracol}{2}`)
   - **LEFT COLUMN:** Profile, Professional Experience (all entries, chronological descending)
   - **RIGHT COLUMN:** Key Strengths (3 items), Technical Skills (5 categories), Languages (6), Courses & Training, Publications
5. **Education section** (full-width, below columns, 2×2 minipage grid)
6. **Signature block** — date + signature image + name
